title: Death of Amenhotep III
summary: Death of the 18th-Dynasty pharaoh Amenhotep III, placed by CFAH from the co-regencies counted from Solomon's death to Akhenaten's accession.
description: Death of the 18th-Dynasty pharaoh Amenhotep III, placed by CFAH from the co-regencies counted from Solomon's death to Akhenaten's accession. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 889 BC plus or minus six months (AP-66, OSF preprint CFAH-8)

chronologies.date: 889 BC plus or minus six months
